## Problem

Orchestra stamps check-runs `runner: "aff"` and close-batch treats that string as runner-produced evidence. Skills (including phase-end) can hand-type the same stamp. Affidavit already owns real evidence via observation → bind → recheck (and signed attest for verdicts), but Orchestra does not gate closes on those verbs. The split looks done; the trust boundary is not.
